syndromes.title: Invasive infection
rows: Use organism-specific recommendations and source control as presented in the 2021 rare-yeast guideline
Guideline first-line: L-AmB; alternative VCZ; fluconazole and echinocandins recommended against
Chen 2021 Rare Yeast Suppl | Fig 28 | PDF p162
Individualize by response, site, susceptibility and source control
Comparative randomized trials are generally unavailable; treatment must follow species identification and susceptibility.
